mapper.select: SELECT rp.place_id AS placeId , p.name AS placeName , pi.file_path AS thumbnail , p.rating AS rating , p.review_count AS reviewCount , DATE_FORMAT(rp.viewed_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS viewedAt FROM recent_place rp LEFT JOIN place p ON rp.place_id = p.id LEFT JOIN place_image pi ON p.id = pi.place_id AND pi.sort_order = 1 WHERE 1 = 1 AND rp.user_email = #{userEmail} ORDER BY rp.viewed_at DESC LIMIT 10
